mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases betamethasone metabolism inhibition, elevating corticosteroid exposure and systemic effects; betamethasone may reduce atazanavir levels through CYP3A4 induction at higher doses.
action: Monitor for corticosteroid toxicity (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider alternative corticosteroid or dose adjustment; maintain vigilance for reduced antiretroviral efficacy.
